Name: Milk Bottles Patches
Author: LinSterling
Description:
[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Description[/size][/color][/b]
With a massive mod list milk items can be all over the place and being a pedant freak looking at this mess is really difficult. The other day I took some serious psychic damage when my cow produced her VMV induced extra large milk and it didn't match the other sizes.
So I decided enough was enough and made this mod to bring them all in line with my favourite milk sprite mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6522]Milk Bottles and Cans[/url].

I also included Saturated/Desaturated option. For original mod and for my sprites to match. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to pick the one you want. Default is Saturated.
Saturation is more noticeable on some bottles than others depending on my cooky colour choices, so mostly it's just for those who are [i]extremely[/i] offended by vibrance.

Individual item toggles added as of 1.6.0. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure to your heart's content. Default is on for all sprites.

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
  1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
  2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
  3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT)[/url] (as of 1.5.1 file version)
  4. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
  5. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6522]Milk Bottles and Cans[/url] - not a requirement technically but why would you even download my mod without it

not required, just the targets of my retexture in no particular order (you can have all of them or just one or any combo, doesn't matter):

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b]
  1. Download
  2. Unzip
  3. Plonk "Milk Bottles Patches" into Stardew Valley\Mods
  4. Should work unless I forked something (in that case, let me know)
  5. Enjoy your milk
  6. Maybe endorse this mod if you liked it? :3

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]Future updates[/b][/size][/color]
  📖 probably more obsessive sprites tweaking
  📖 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39812]The Arcanian Exchange[/url] (got permission, gonna work on sprites soon)

if you want me to take a crack at milk from some other mod, feel free to make suggestions. no promises that I'll jump right to it though, I'm a serial procrastinator working in occasional bursts of activity.
also, I probably won't take any errr "milk" requests, as in 18+ mods with "milking" in them. you know what I mean. none of that, please.
